reason: A browser sound notification plugin that alerts users when confirmation is needed or an agent task completes, with configurable audio settings and playback/status tools.

summaries.zh: 在需要用户确认或任务完成时通过浏览器播放可配置提示音，并提供静音、音量、音效选择及试听功能。
summaries.en: Plays configurable browser sound notifications when user confirmation is needed or an agent task completes, with mute, volume, sound selection, and preview controls.

capabilities: Plays synthesized browser audio for approval requests and task completion events
Provides settings for muting, volume, sound selection, and preview
Exposes sonic_play and sonic_status tools and local notification state routes
